name: Ray
source:
Ray is a pure-blood vampire from a distinguished family and is the 2nd highest-ranked species in the hierarchy (after mermaids). However, as there are currently no mermaids in attendance at the school, he considers himself to be the most important person at school and has the fan club to prove it. He is good at pretty much everything and is super arrogant about it but has a mean sense of humour and likes to make jokes out of other characters, particularly Shiba. As with all vampires, he loves “beautiful things” and so takes a keen interest in Chloe.

[From [url=https://zettairenai.wordpress.com/2018/02/23/ps-vita-ephemeral-fantasy-on-dark-review/]Zettai Renai[/url]]
